ButcherMasteryHamstringInvigoration.name: Invigoration
ButcherMasteryHamstringInvigoration.description: If Hamstring hits a Hero, half of the Mana cost is refunded and the cooldown is reduced by 1 second.

GenericTalentBlock.name: Block
GenericTalentBlock.description: Every 5 seconds, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Stores up to 2 charges.

ButcherMasteryHamstringChopMeat.name: Chop Meat
ButcherMasteryHamstringChopMeat.description: Increases Hamstring damage by 100% to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

ButcherMasteryHamstringFlailAxe.name: Flail Axe
ButcherMasteryHamstringFlailAxe.description: Increases the length of Hamstring by 40%.

ButcherMasteryRuthlessOnslaughtUnrelenti.name: Unrelenting Pursuit
ButcherMasteryRuthlessOnslaughtUnrelenti.description: Reduces the cooldown of Ruthless Onslaught by 33% upon impact.

ButcherMasteryHamstringCheapShot.name: Cheap Shot
ButcherMasteryHamstringCheapShot.description: Hamstring does 100% more damage to targets affected by a Slow, Root, or Stun.

ButcherMasteryButchersBrandInsatiableBla.name: Insatiable Blade
ButcherMasteryButchersBrandInsatiableBla.description: While facing a branded enemy, The Butcher's Movement Speed is increased by 25%.

ButcherMasteryFreshMeatVictuals.name: Victuals
ButcherMasteryFreshMeatVictuals.description: Every time a nearby enemy minion dies, The Butcher heals 5% of his maximum health.

ButcherMeatShield.name: Meat Shield
ButcherMeatShield.description: When Ruthless Onslaught impacts an enemy Hero, The Butcher gains 50 Spell Armor for 2.5 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 50%.

ButcherHeroicAbilityButcherFurnaceBlast.name: Furnace Blast
ButcherHeroicAbilityButcherFurnaceBlast.description: After a 3 second delay, fire explodes around The Butcher dealing 500 (+4% per level) damage to enemies. Can be cast while using Ruthless Onslaught.

ButcherHeroicAbilityLambToTheSlaughter.name: Lamb to the Slaughter
ButcherHeroicAbilityLambToTheSlaughter.description: Throw a hitching post that attaches to the nearest enemy Hero after a 1 second delay. This deals 171 (+4% per level) damage and causes the enemy to be chained to the post and Silenced for 3 seconds.

ButcherCleaver.name: Cleaver
ButcherCleaver.description: Basic Attacks deal 35% of The Butcher's Basic Attack Damage in an area around the target.

ButcherMasteryRuthlessOnslaughtSavageCha.name: Savage Charge
ButcherMasteryRuthlessOnslaughtSavageCha.description: Ruthless Onslaught deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 10% of their maximum Health.

ButcherMasteryHamstringBrutalStrike.name: Brutal Strike
ButcherMasteryHamstringBrutalStrike.description: After using Hamstring, The Butcher's next 3 Basic Attacks within 5 seconds deal an additional 15% damage.

ButcherMasteryHamstringCripplingSlam.name: Crippling Slam
ButcherMasteryHamstringCripplingSlam.description: Hamstring's slow no longer fades out, and the duration is increased by 30%.

ButcherTalentEnraged.name: Enraged
ButcherTalentEnraged.description: While below 50% of his maximum Health, taking damage causes The Butcher to become Enraged for 10 seconds, gaining 40% Attack Speed and 25 Armor, reducing damage taken by 25%. This effect has a 25 second cooldown.

ButcherMasteryFreshMeatBloodFrenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
ButcherMasteryFreshMeatBloodFrenzy.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant 5% increased Attack and Movement Speed for 3 seconds, up to 25%.

ButcherMasteryFiresofHell.name: Fires of Hell
ButcherMasteryFiresofHell.description: Furnace Blast explodes a second time 3 seconds after the initial explosion.

ButcherMasterySlaughterhouse.name: Slaughterhouse
ButcherMasterySlaughterhouse.description: Lamb to the Slaughter now chains all enemy Heroes in range.

GenericTalentNexusBlades.name: Nexus Blades
GenericTalentNexusBlades.description: Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage and Slow enemy Movement Speed by 20% for 1 second.

GenericTalentFlashoftheStorms.name: Bolt of the Storm
GenericTalentFlashoftheStorms.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.
